name: Eagle's Nest Sink (Chassahowitzka WMA)
area: Northwest of Weeki Wachee, Hernando County
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 23, 2026 research.
navigationAddress: Chassahowitzka Wildlife Management Area main entrance, Rattlesnake Camp Road, Weeki Wachee FL
navigationNote: Drive to the main entrance and follow the posted WMA map to the appropriate parking area and boardwalk. Check interior road and gate conditions.
experience: From above it looks like a green, marshy pond in a swamp; the show is underwater. A wooden boardwalk and stairs go down into the sink, with benches on the dock, an information sign, picnic tables and a vault toilet at the parking area. Scuba diving needs a state registration on file before you dive, and by long-standing practice only full-cave divers dive here; it has a long record of deaths. That registration covers scuba only: no rule found bans swimming or freediving, but visibility swings from gin-clear to near zero with rainfall, and there is no shallow safe section.
cost: Daily-use permit $3 per person or $6 per vehicle, paid at the entrance fee station
access: Enter Chassahowitzka Wildlife Management Area and pay at the fee station (cash in the envelope, hang the tag). The last miles are rough gravel with big potholes; little or no cell signal. General gun season runs Nov 7, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027: wear orange. Outside hunt periods the area is open from 1.5 hours before sunrise to 1.5 hours after sunset. Expect mosquitoes and ticks.

conditions.summary: State wildlife agency pages read November 23, 2026: scuba registration required, vault toilets at the Eagles Nest parking area, $3/$6 daily fee, general gun season Nov 7 - Jan 3. Water clarity not checked. (source dated 2026-11-23)
